ui_bugs.issue: White-on-white text: the button computed style is backgroundColor rgb(255,255,255) AND color rgb(255,255,255). Screenshot confirms an empty white pill on the teal section with no visible label in BOTH light and dark. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx:533 uses className='bg-white text-primary-k ...' inside a parent that carries the .force-white utility (see /app/frontend/src/index.css:283-287) which overrides .text-primary-k to rgba(255,255,255,0.8) !important — so the intended teal text is force-whitened away. Fix: either replace text-primary-k with an inline style={{color:'#0E4D52'}} / a non-overridable class (e.g. text-[#0E4D52]) OR add an exception in the .force-white rule for .bg-white .text-primary-k. Adjacent 'Or try a free AI tool' outline button is correct (transparent bg, white text, 2px solid white border).

critical_code_review_comments: The '.force-white .text-primary-k -> rgba(255,255,255,0.8) !important' rule (index.css:283-287) is intentionally aggressive so nested overlines/eyebrows go white on the teal panel — but it's now silently breaking any WHITE-backgrounded CTA that lives inside a .force-white ancestor. Recommend narrowing the selector to '.force-white :not(.bg-white) .text-primary-k' or introducing a semantic .text-on-white utility for buttons/pills placed on force-white sections.

rca of the issue: Landing final-cta-signup: className='bg-white text-primary-k ...' is nested inside a section that carries .force-white; .force-white .text-primary-k has a '!important' override to rgba(255,255,255,0.8), so the intended teal text collapses to white and disappears on the white pill. Fix at the call site (inline color / different class) or narrow the force-white selector to skip .bg-white descendants.
